description: Fires once per PR head SHA when its checks settle not green. Same-repo, non-draft PRs of repos in vars.fixer_repos only; vars.fixer_excluded_repos overrides it. Shares the pr-fixer workflow and the per-PR concurrency key and attempt budget with the other pr-fixer-* rules.
name: PR fixer: checks settled

on_failure.name: Hand back with the run link

params.body:
PR fixer handed back ({{ run.error.code }}): {{ run.error.message }}

Run: https://rules.culture.dev/api/runs/{{ run.id }}

inputs.instruction: Checks on PR {{ trigger.data.repository }}#{{ trigger.data.number }} settled ({{ trigger.data.conclusion }}) at {{ trigger.data.head_sha }}. Work on the PR head branch {{ trigger.data.head_branch }} only. Fix the failing checks and the SonarCloud issues on this PR, and address the review threads in the threads input (and no other thread). Never edit .github/workflows, never delete or skip tests and never add suppression markers. In threads_addressed, use each thread's thread_id exactly as the threads input gives it.
